sources.title: heallen02/albef-classification · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Albef for Classification Overview This repository is a compact, custom PyTorch implementation of Albef for Classification. The tiny configuration is intended for code review, smoke tests, and small controlled experiments rather than as a production-ready pretrained release.

sources.title: Retraining an ALBERT Model for Intent Classification
sources.snippet: 5. Model Training Training the ALBERT model for intent classification is a crucial step where the model learns to accurately predict user intents based on the input data.
